review: Here is what I would say to that. I taught thirty-one years and ran a school of nine hundred, and I use a song the way I used to use a film clip — one, at the exact right moment, to make a point land that will not land any other way. "Old Self Buried" did that in March and thirty-five adults who never talk, talked. Now the practical matter. I need the lyrics as printed text so I can put them on a handout, and there are none anywhere on this site. I am currently transcribing by ear, at sixty-one, which is not a good use of anybody's Tuesday.
